## Affected callers
- `record_hit` requires `enclosing_code_unit` to return a declaration before inserting a usage (`src/analyzer/usages/js_ts_graph/hits.rs:24`). That lookup selects the smallest containing declaration range (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:1114`), including the root-node module range registered at `src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123` and `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`.
- `get_sources` slices source using declaration ranges, taking the non-function branch for modules (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:1264`). The JS/TS module registrations (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`) therefore supply ranges to source retrieval as well as usage attribution.
- `signature_elements` reads declaration ranges (`src/searchtools.rs:1162`) and sets each element extent to the maximum of its signature line count and matching range line count, retaining the signature text (`src/searchtools.rs:1176`, `src/searchtools.rs:1190`, `src/searchtools.rs:1198`); the JS/TS registrations supply the root range alongside the import signature (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`).
- `summarize_files` iterates top-level declarations in their iterator order (`src/searchtools.rs:717`); the iterator exposes the stored vector (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:927`). The module registration after the child traversal (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`) uses `add_code_unit`, which appends parentless units (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:148`).
- `route_summary_targets` calls `resolve_file_patterns` and classifies nonempty results as file targets (`src/searchtools.rs:480`); its literal lookup now accepts the `ProjectFile` returned by the project directly (`src/searchtools.rs:1347`).
- `list_symbols_with_reader` consumes `resolve_file_patterns` results for file counts and symbol output (`src/searchtools.rs:757`); when its reader returns an error, it assigns a line count of zero (`src/searchtools.rs:764`). Literal results enter this path through `src/searchtools.rs:1349`.

## Paths
- `TreeSitterAnalyzer::analyze_file` reads through `Project::read_source`, parses a tree, and calls the language adapter (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:439`), reaching the JS and TS root-module registrations (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`).
- ES import statements and CommonJS require bindings set `module_has_imports` in both adapters (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:82`, `src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:109`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:86`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:116`); these branches converge on the module registrations at `src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123` and `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`.
- The literal branch inserts a project lookup result and continues (`src/searchtools.rs:1349`), before directory expansion (`src/searchtools.rs:1355`). Glob patterns take a separate route that enumerates `analyzed_files` (`src/searchtools.rs:1361`), with both routes feeding the same deduplicating set.
- The clone fixtures are written before the server process starts (`tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:26`, `tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:53`, `tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:99`). Only `SampleTest.java` is added to the initial Git index (`tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:82`); the later refresh request precedes the report request naming both clone fixtures (`tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:314`, `tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:341`).

## Value flow
- The registered module identity comes from `module_code_unit`, which constructs a `Module` with an empty package and the file basename (`src/analyzer/js_ts/model.rs:8`); both adapters obtain that identity before passing it to registration (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:74`, `src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:78`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`).
- `add_code_unit` records `node_range(node)` in `ParsedFile::ranges` (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:153`); the adapter calls supply the tree root (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`), and `analyze_file` transfers those ranges into `FileState` (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:459`).
- Literal pattern lookup (`src/searchtools.rs:1349`) receives values from project-specific implementations: `FilesystemProject` returns a constructed path when `exists()` is true (`src/analyzer/project.rs:222`), while the searchtools test `CountingProject` checks membership in its supplied file set (`src/searchtools.rs:1685`). The literal-pattern test expects `nested/B.java` and zero analyzed-file enumerations (`src/searchtools.rs:1870`).
- The added expected Java name (`tests/java_declarations_parity.rs:62`) comes from the package and class declarations in `tests/fixtures/testcode-java/PackagedSibling.java:1`. The assertion's actual values are class-filtered, fully qualified names from `get_all_declarations` (`tests/java_declarations_parity.rs:17`).
- The new usage fixture imports `absVal` using `../Abs` (`tests/usages_js_ts_graph_test.rs:484`). Relative module resolution joins the specifier to the importing file's parent (`src/analyzer/js_ts/imports.rs:358`) and probes language extensions (`src/analyzer/js_ts/imports.rs:403`), matching the fixture's `Maths/Abs.js` path (`tests/usages_js_ts_graph_test.rs:479`).
